class.name: NetwTimeline
class.brief_description: The recent state and input of an entity, by tick.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a timeline that keeps [param limit] ticks. [code]new()[/code] keeps [constant DEFAULT_LIMIT].

method.name: floor
method.description: Returns the tick passed to [method trim_before]. Entries before it are ignored.

method.name: has_input_at
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an input snapshot is recorded at [param tick].

method.name: input_at
method.description: Returns the input at [param tick], or an empty [Dictionary].

method.name: inputs_in_range
method.description: Returns the inputs from [param from] to [param to], both included, oldest first. Ticks with no input are skipped. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴entry ┠╴tick int the tick ┖╴input Dictionary the input at that tick [/codeblock]

method.name: latest_state_at_or_before
method.description: Returns the newest state at or before [param tick], or an empty [Dictionary].

method.name: latest_state_tick_at_or_before
method.description: Returns the tick of the state [method latest_state_at_or_before] returns, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: newest_input_tick
method.description: Returns the newest tick with an input, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: record_input
method.description: Records the input [param snapshot] at [param tick].

method.name: record_state
method.description: Records the state [param snapshot] at [param tick].

method.name: state_at
method.description: Returns the state recorded at exactly [param tick], or an empty [Dictionary].

method.name: trim_before
method.description: Ignores entries before [param tick] from now on. It cannot move back.

constants.constant: The default number of ticks kept, about one second at 60 ticks per second.
